RED-TEAM, do not fix anything. Goal: find every input on which the collapse-by-default decision and layering (PR 469's design: one decision function `CollapseInheritedProps::collapses`, per-source reaching count, threshold 200 / ambient 30, per-source expand set, `layer_checker_props`, `Layering`/`keeps`, `move_notable`, picked keys, notable props, structural AND checker lanes) gives a WRONG output: a prop that should be listed but is hidden in a layer (worst: silent loss), a prop listed twice or in both a layer and the list, a wrong/missing notable prop (className, onClick, style, children, key, ref...), a lane disagreement (structural vs checker lane for the same component with the checker on, off, and merged), or an unstable output. Target: branch `fix/collapse-never-hide-on-silence` (head 6aea3f4a, local ref in this repo: `git branch -a --contains 6aea3f4a`; its base is origin/feat/collapse-large-sources-by-default f29013d5/7d2a1c7f). Read /Users/gabe/Projects/caliper-fixtures/worker-contract.md, /Users/gabe/Projects/caliper-fixtures/shrink/findings-synthesis.md (C1 silence-as-evidence, C5 two owners), /Users/gabe/Projects/caliper-fixtures/pr/fix-collapse-never-hide-on-silence.md and fix-collapse-picked-notable.md (what was fixed, stated limits), crates/core/src/types/semantic.rs, types/options.rs, resolver/mod.rs, resolver/alias.rs, crates/semantic/tests/collapse_model.rs (the existing 300+ case model; its generator only covers forms the authors thought of).
Method: enumerate the GRAMMAR of props types the user code can have, project-local and dependency: interface/type literal/class with extends chains; intersections of local + dependency + DOM (`React.ComponentProps<'div'>`, `HTMLAttributes`, `ComponentPropsWithoutRef`, `JSX.IntrinsicElements`); Pick/Omit/Partial/Required of a big source (direct, via alias, via generic instantiation, nested, with `keyof` and string unions, with type parameter keys); mapped types with `as`; conditional types and `PropsOf<typeof X>`; `typeof Component` props via `ComponentProps`; discriminated unions; generics with defaults; polymorphic `as` props; `forwardRef`/`memo`/factory-wrapped components; sources defined in one file and re-exported; sources with the same member name in two different sources (declared in one, redeclared or narrowed in the component's own interface: own redeclared props must stay own); a source exactly at the threshold (199/200/201 reaching, ambient 29/30/31) and with members removed by Omit that drop it under the threshold; sources shared by many components (stable layer identity); `notable` html attrs on a collapsed layer with defaults in destructuring (`{className = 'x'}`) and JSDoc; collapse option values (`none`, `dependencies`, `all`) in both lanes plus the addon default; `--no-checker`, checker timeout, merged. Build generated projects under /Users/gabe/Projects/caliper-fixtures/redteam-collapse/ (not /tmp) with a script kept there (scratch, not committed), build the caliper binary from the target branch (own CARGO_TARGET_DIR under /Users/gabe/Projects/caliper-fixtures/shrink/, rust 1.99.1 first on PATH /Users/gabe/.rustup/toolchains/1.99.1-aarch64-apple-darwin/bin), run each project through structural-only, checker-only (if possible) and merged, and apply a ground-truth oracle: the set of props that REACH the component per the TypeScript compiler API (`getPropertiesOfType` on the component's props type, with declarations/parents) versus (list + all layer members + notableInherited). Invariants to assert: (1) every reaching prop appears exactly once across list, notable, and layers (no loss, no duplicate); (2) own props are never in a layer; (3) a collapsed layer's members all reach the component; (4) lane agreement on which sources collapse; (5) determinism across two runs. Group failures by the root fact the decision lacked, minimal repros, counts; propose the closed allow-list (what must be proven for a source to collapse; everything else listed). Also record how many components on gate-large/chakra-only/shadcn-ui would be listed instead of collapsed under that allow-list (size cost). Deliverable: /Users/gabe/Projects/caliper-fixtures/shrink/redteam-collapse.md. No repo file changes, no push. Cap 90 tool calls. Final message at most 70 words: number of distinct discrepancy classes, the worst, the path.

# Worker contract (caliper). Read once; the brief only names the task, the files you own and the call cap.

Scope
- Edit only the files the brief names. If another file must change, stop and say which and why.
- Never ask the user questions. If blocked, report what blocks and what you tried. Do not wait on background work: finish or report.

Branch and push
- Branch from origin/main unless the brief says otherwise. Own CARGO_TARGET_DIR under ~/Projects/caliper-fixtures/<task>/. Scratch there too, never /tmp.
- Rust 1.99.1 on PATH (/Users/gabe/.rustup/toolchains/1.99.1-aarch64-apple-darwin/bin) for builds; commits need MISE_RUST_VERSION=1.99.1 (the mise shim forces 1.98.1). Caveat: with the toolchain bin first on PATH `rust-objcopy` can fail and strip silently does nothing; irrelevant unless you measure binary size.
- Signed commits ending `Claude-Session: https://claude.ai/code/session_013R2ytvK9B32ZaSUaSe6aAZ`. Push normally (`git push origin HEAD:<branch>`), never --no-verify, verify the remote SHA with `git ls-remote`. Do not open or edit the PR, do not poll CI.

Checks: targeted, CI runs the rest
- Always, before push: `just lint doc-check machete typos` (fast).
- Then only what your change touches: Rust -> nextest of the touched crates; types/output/merge -> `just test-checker-lane` once; checker/session code -> gate_harness determinism and memory modes; output-preserving change -> full-content diff (JSON parsed, `stats` dropped) of `extract --json --quiet --no-cache` vs a build of origin/main on ~/Projects/caliper-fixtures/gate-large/src and ~/Projects/caliper-fixtures/checker-default/chakra-only/src (tools: ~/Projects/caliper-fixtures/perf-analysis/same.py, identity.sh; ~/Projects/caliper-fixtures/final-perf/ab.sh interleaves two binaries).
- Do NOT run deny, semver, test-ts, test-napi, test-integration, test-py unless you changed those areas: CI runs them on every PR.
- Tests that fail on base for every behavior change. No oracle runs, no corpus fetches. No new scripts, options or recipes. Changeset only if `just semver` demands one.
- No wall-clock timing unless the brief asks; check `uptime`, and prefer allocation or instruction counts (load-independent).

Cap
- Stop and report after the call cap in the brief (default 60 tool calls) with what you have verified. Listing something as 'not done' with its cause beats burning more calls.

Artifacts (agents to agents; humans see them at the edge)
- Write the PR body to ~/Projects/caliper-fixtures/pr/<branch, slashes as dashes>.md: `## What`, `## Evidence` (numbers, exit codes, what was diffed), `## Not verified`, last line `https://claude.ai/code/session_013R2ytvK9B32ZaSUaSe6aAZ`. The lead publishes it unedited.
- Final message <= 120 words: branch, head SHA (ls-remote verified), body path, blockers. Nothing else.

Pre-push gate (the reviewer must find nothing new; read ~/Projects/caliper-fixtures/shrink/findings-synthesis.md, classes C1-C8)
- Guards are ALLOW-lists: handle a closed set of proven forms, everything else is Unknown/Declined (never 'complete', never 'none', never 'exact'). No `_ =>` arms in decisions over node/type kinds.
- Write the slice's invariants in the PR body (unknown unless proven; by binding not spelling; every read recorded; one owner; wired or not defined).
- Grammar sweep: list every syntax/type form the code can receive and show each is handled or declined (exhaustive match, or a generated test over the grammar with the checker/TS API as oracle). Generate over the GRAMMAR, not over past findings.
- Mutation proof: remove each guard/dependency; a test must fail. Report which you tried.
- Before reporting: run `/code-review medium` on your explicit SHA range, then try to break your own change with inputs the diff did not mention (computed keys, symbols, getters, overloads, re-exports, shadowing, optional chains, declare/abstract, conditional types).
# Findings synthesis (trails 404/405, ~50 Entire findings, 2026-11-15)

Why reviewers keep finding things: every finding is an instance of one of eight classes. Each fix so far closed the
instance, not the class, and most guards are DENY-lists (enumerate what is wrong) where the rule needs an ALLOW-list
(enumerate what is proven, decline the rest). A deny-list is complete only until the next grammar form: the newest
finding (273: `Partial<Config>` with a `[Symbol.iterator]` key) is the same class as the six before it.

| # | Class (semantic invariant that was broken) | Findings (change) | Class-level remedy |
|---|---|---|---|
| C1 | Silence is not evidence: absent data was treated as 'complete/none' | declare fn = complete empty body, optional-chain computed member (268); alias Pick over checker-only source collapses (267 x6); name-only filter hides another source's prop (277); `used` empty (281) | Unknown is the default state; Complete is earned. Exhaustive `match` on node/type kinds, no wildcard arm, the default arm is `Unknown`/`Declined`. One rule in the one decision function: not proven => keep listed. |
| C2 | Lossy model asserted exactness (deny-list guard) | Omit/keyof index sig, Array shadow, scope, Partial<Dict>, readonly, Required undefined (273), Symbol.iterator key (273 new) | ALLOW-list expansion: expand only members of a closed set of simple forms (identifier or string-literal key, plain/optional/readonly known, non-generic), decline everything else. Oracle generator iterates the GRAMMAR of member/key forms, not the findings. |
| C3 | Spelling used where binding is required | JSX usage by name, builtin `Array` by spelling, shadowed tags, AtFile scope, three path predicates for ambient/React | Resolve by binding or return unknown; one `declaration_origin`; no string equality on identifiers in decisions. |
| C4 | Derived state outside the dependency model | stale watch/lazy relevance (281), call-site cache, scheduler re-ask after edit (279/282) | Everything an answer reads is recorded (`deps`) or the answer is not kept; `watch_equals_fresh` model with mutation proof per dependency kind. |
| C5 | One decision, two owners | collapse lanes (267, 4 rounds), picked keys (4 readers), `annotate` x3, `{...props}` meaning, relevance map vs ADR | One function, one sink, provenance `(source, key, how)` not counts/names; lanes feed inputs, never decide. |
| C6 | Host assumptions | cgroup v1 mount (272) | Read the system's own description (mountinfo); fall back loudly. Fixed. |
| C7 | Hand-tuned policy without a reference model | scheduler fairness/starvation (279/281) | Property test against a reference model (sort by class, arrival) with the starvation rule as the spec. |
| C8 | Contract drift: code, ADR, schema disagree; fields defined but never populated | schema 8 per-component map vs ADR `used`, dead story-args, `used` empty on corpora, 281 | ADR is the contract; a field ships only with a producer, a consumer and a corpus count that is non-zero. |

Plus a process class: stacked PRs show the same code in every child (about 40% of the raw count) and merge commits
re-expose it. Remedy: merge in order, review once, retarget children.

## Pre-push gate (every slice, before the Entire reviewer ever sees it)

1. Invariants: write the 3 to 6 invariants of the slice in the PR body in these terms: 'unknown unless proven',
   'resolved by binding', 'every read recorded', 'one owner', 'wired or not defined'.
2. Grammar sweep: list every syntactic or type form the touched code can receive (all AST node kinds, all member
   and key forms, all declaration kinds) and show each one is handled or lands in the Unknown/Declined arm, by an
   EXHAUSTIVE match (no `_ =>`) or a generated test over the grammar with the oracle (checker, TS API) as judge.
3. Mutation proof: for each guard or dependency, remove it and show a test fails. A guard no test can fail is not a guard.
4. Adversarial pass: a reviewer that did not write the code gets the pattern list C1 to C8 and the grammar list and
   must try to produce a wrong output (not read the diff for style). Fix once, at the class level.
5. Then `/code-review medium` on the explicit SHA range, then push.
## What

Closes the last collapse findings on PR 469 (trail 405, change 267). Finding A is a `Pick` over a large source that only the checker reads, written through a project alias or a conditional `PropsOf`. Finding B2 (01M7GP00RW3J) is a layer hiding a prop by its name alone.

Principle: never hide on silence (ADR 0028, 1e4a5283). If the checker cannot prove that nothing was selected away, the source is listed, not collapsed.

The rule has one owner, `checker_sources` in `crates/core/src/types/semantic.rs`. A source the structural answer did not read becomes a layer only when it is in `SemanticComponent::whole`.

- `whole` replaces `picked`. It holds the interfaces the checker proved the props type reaches whole, named the way a prop's `parent` names them.
- `Converter::composes` in `crates/semantic/src/convert.rs` builds `whole` during the walk it already makes. It is an allow-list. A type is reached whole only through these edges:
  - the props type itself;
  - an intersection's members;
  - a class's or interface's bases (for a generic one, its target's);
  - the lib's own `Partial`, `Required`, `Readonly` and `Omit`. They are recognised by the lib alias the checker reports. `Omit` only removes keys, and the members left are exactly the answer's props.
- A lib `Pick` marks what it applies to as selected. A source that is selected anywhere is never whole.
- Every other type is not looked into, so nothing under it is proven:
  - a mapped type;
  - a project alias of a mapped type or of `Pick`/`Omit`. The lib writes `Omit` as `Pick<T, Exclude<…>>`, and TypeScript names the type by the outermost alias, so the two cannot be told apart.
  - a conditional, a union, or a type whose bases are unknown.
- B2: a layer now holds a prop by (source, name). The prop's `parent` must be the layer's source. This applies to `keeps`, to `LayerFacts::members` and to the notable check of a layer the answer adds. A prop with no `parent` is no source's member, so no layer holds it.
- The stored answer format is bumped to 2, because the field changed.

Invariants:

- Unknown unless proven. Collapsing needs `whole`. An empty or missing `whole` means listed.
- Matched by binding, not spelling. A source is identified by (interface name, declaring file) from the checker's symbol. A prop belongs to a layer by (name, source), never by name alone.
- One owner. Both lanes (`layer_checker_props` and `Layering::kept`) call `checker_sources` with the same `whole`.
- Wired or not defined. The `picked` machinery is deleted: the `properties` call per `Pick` and the name list are gone.

## Evidence

- Tests first. On base 6051a50c (origin/feat/collapse-large-sources-by-default merged with origin/main), these failed:
  - `crates/semantic/tests/collapse_model.rs`:
    - `a_checker_only_source_collapses_only_where_it_is_proven_to_reach_whole`, the grammar sweep (17 props-type forms, each expected to collapse or to stay listed);
    - `a_prop_of_another_source_is_not_hidden_by_a_layer_member_of_its_name` (B2: `b5` was hidden);
    - `finding_a_…`, whose `NamedPick250` case is now asserted (it was skipped as a known limit).
  - Core unit tests `a_layer_holds_a_prop_by_its_source_and_name_not_by_its_name_alone` and `a_source_only_the_checker_read_is_listed_unless_the_checker_proved_it_reaches_whole` are new.
- Grammar sweep outcomes on a 700-member source only the checker reads:
  - Collapsed:
    - direct `PropsOf<typeof Widget>`;
    - `interface extends`;
    - an intersection;
    - `Gen<string>`;
    - `Partial`, `Required` and `Readonly`;
    - `type NamedPartial = Partial<S>`, because TypeScript keeps the lib alias;
    - lib `Omit` (699).
  - Listed:
    - direct `Pick`;
    - `Pick & S`;
    - `interface extends Pick`;
    - `type = Pick`;
    - `type = Omit`;
    - a project mapped alias;
    - generic mapped aliases (`Opt<S>` and `Selected<S, K>`).
  - Not swept:
    - a union props type: it falls back to the structural answer;
    - `ComponentProps<'el'>`: it is React-declared, never a checker-only source.

38	/// Which inherited sources are recorded as an `InheritedLayer` of names instead of expanded prop by prop (collapse).
39	/// A component's own props type is always expanded. A dependency source collapses when it is ambient (DOM and ARIA
40	/// attributes, style systems) and declares more than 30 props; a dependency's own API is listed unless it declares more
41	/// than 200 props. By default a project source declaring more than 200 props collapses too.
42	#[derive(Debug, Clone, Copy, PartialEq, Eq, Hash, Default, Serialize, Deserialize)]
43	#[serde(rename_all = "camelCase")]
44	pub enum CollapseInheritedProps {
45	    /// Large ambient sources declared in a loaded dependency (`load_dependencies`), a dependency's sources of more than
46	    /// 200 props, and the project's own sources of more than 200 props. The default.
47	    #[default]
48	    Dependencies,
49	    /// Those, and the project's own sources of more than 30 props.
50	    All,
51	    /// Expand every source.
52	    None,
53	}
54	
55	impl CollapseInheritedProps {
56	    /// The mode named by a config or binding string. `Err` carries the unrecognized value.
57	    pub fn parse(s: &str) -> Result<Self, &str> {
58	        match s {
59	            "dependencies" => Ok(Self::Dependencies),
60	            "all" => Ok(Self::All),
61	            "none" => Ok(Self::None),
62	            other => Err(other),
63	        }
64	    }
65	
66	    /// Whether an inherited source of type `type_name` in `file`, of which `reaching` props reach the component, is
67	    /// recorded as a layer of names instead of listed prop by prop. `dependency` says the file is a loaded dependency's.
68	    /// A component's own props type is never asked.
69	    ///
70	    /// The one owner of the decision, and both lanes give it the same input, `reaching`; no declared member count is
71	    /// read anywhere. `reaching` is the number of distinct
72	    /// members of the source that reach the component after `Omit` and `Pick` (a member reached through two paths counts
73	    /// once). For a plain `extends` it is what the source declares. A `Pick` names its keys on purpose, so the props it
74	    /// picks are listed however large the source: neither lane asks about them. The structural resolver expands what a
75	    /// `Pick` applies to, and counts the members a source declares less the keys the `Omit`s around it take
76	    /// (`ResolveState::omitted`, so only that source is affected); the checker's merge counts the props of its answer
77	    /// whose `parent` is the source, which are exactly the members that reach, and asks only for a source the checker
78	    /// proved the props type reaches whole: one under a `Pick`, a mapped type or a project alias of either is listed
79	    /// without asking (`SemanticComponent::whole`, `crate::types::semantic::layer_checker_props`).
80	    ///
81	    /// - A dependency source collapses when it is ambient (`crate::types::ambient`: DOM and ARIA attributes, style
82	    ///   systems) and past [`COLLAPSE_THRESHOLD`] props, or when it is not ambient but past [`LARGE_API_SOURCE`] props.
83	    ///   Otherwise it is listed: what a dependency's component exposes is the API a reader needs typed, and a small
84	    ///   ambient source costs more as a layer than as props.
85	    /// - A project source collapses past [`LARGE_API_SOURCE`] props in the default mode, as a dependency source that is
86	    ///   not ambient does: a style system is as large in the project's own source (Chakra's `SystemProperties`
87	    ///   declares 705) as installed. Its name is not read. Under [`Self::All`] it collapses past
88	    ///   [`COLLAPSE_THRESHOLD`].
89	    /// - A file in `node_modules` that is not a dependency's (`@types/react`, TypeScript's libraries) never collapses:
90	    ///   React's attributes follow `htmlAttributes`.
91	    /// - Under [`Self::None`] nothing collapses.
92	    pub(crate) fn collapses(self, dependency: bool, file: &str, type_name: &str, reaching: usize) -> bool {
93	        let project_threshold = match self {
94	            Self::None => return false,
95	            Self::Dependencies => LARGE_API_SOURCE,
96	            Self::All => COLLAPSE_THRESHOLD,
97	        };
98	        if dependency {
99	            let ambient = crate::types::ambient::is_ambient_source(file, type_name);
100	            reaching > if ambient { COLLAPSE_THRESHOLD } else { LARGE_API_SOURCE }
101	        } else {
102	            reaching > project_threshold && !in_node_modules(file)
103	        }
104	    }
105	}
106	
107	/// What a merge of the checker's answer needs to decide a collapse of a source only the checker read: the run's mode
108	/// and whether it loads dependencies, so a source in `node_modules` is a dependency's exactly when the structural pass
109	/// would have loaded it (`CollapseInheritedProps::collapses`'s `dependency`).
110	#[derive(Debug, Clone, Copy, PartialEq, Eq, Hash)]
111	pub struct CollapseContext {
112	    /// The run's `collapseInheritedProps`.
113	    pub mode: CollapseInheritedProps,
114	    /// The run's `loadDependencies`.
115	    pub load_dependencies: bool,
116	}
117	
118	impl CollapseContext {
119	    /// Collapses nothing the structural answer did not: what a merge whose caller gives no options uses.
120	    pub const OFF: Self = Self { mode: CollapseInheritedProps::None, load_dependencies: false };
121	
122	    /// The run's choices.
123	    pub fn of(options: &PipelineOptions) -> Self {
124	        Self { mode: options.collapse_inherited_props, load_dependencies: options.load_dependencies }
125	    }
126	
127	    /// Whether a source only the checker read collapses: `reaching` of its members reach the component
128	    /// ([`CollapseInheritedProps::collapses`]), and its file is a dependency's when it is in `node_modules` and the run
129	    /// loads dependencies.
130	    pub(crate) fn collapses(self, file: &str, type_name: &str, reaching: usize) -> bool {
131	        let dependency = self.load_dependencies && in_node_modules(file);
132	        (dependency || !in_node_modules(file)) && self.mode.collapses(dependency, file, type_name, reaching)
133	    }
134	}

136	/// A source declaring more than this many props can collapse: an ambient dependency source (`crate::types::ambient`),
137	/// or a project source under [`CollapseInheritedProps::All`]. Storybook's react-component-meta hides a dependency
138	/// source contributing more than this many props, whatever it contains; here an API source is hidden only past
139	/// [`LARGE_API_SOURCE`].
140	pub(crate) const COLLAPSE_THRESHOLD: usize = 30;
141	
142	/// Any other source collapses past this many props by default: a dependency source that is not ambient by name, or a
143	/// project source. It is a style system, not an API. Chakra v3's `SystemProperties` declares 705 and, listed, took a
144	/// four-component app from 516 KB to 1.96 MB; the largest source that is an API in the pinned corpora and in apps on
145	/// Chakra, Mantine and MUI declares 75 (`docs/measurement.md`, "Collapse by relevance").
146	pub(crate) const LARGE_API_SOURCE: usize = 200;
147	
148	/// Whether `path` is inside a `node_modules` directory.
149	pub(crate) fn in_node_modules(path: &str) -> bool {
150	    path.contains("/node_modules/") || path.contains(r"\node_modules\")
151	}

import json, os, pathlib, subprocess, sys, collections

NM = pathlib.Path("/Users/gabe/Projects/caliper-fixtures/live-demo/node_modules")
TSCONFIG = '{ "compilerOptions": { "strict": true, "jsx": "react-jsx", "module": "esnext", "moduleResolution": "bundler", "target": "esnext", "skipLibCheck": true }, "include": ["src"] }'
NOTABLE = ["onClick", "onFocus", "onBlur", "className", "style", "id", "tabIndex", "aria-label"]


def members(prefix, n, extra=()):

    out = list(extra)

        i += 1
    return out


def iface(name, names, ext="", kw="export interface"):
    body = "\n".join(f"  /** doc {m} */\n  {quote(m)}?: {typ(m)};" for m in names)

def alias(name, names, kw="export type"):
    body = "\n".join(f"  {quote(m)}?: {typ(m)};" for m in names)
    return f"{kw} {name} = {{\n{body}\n}};\n"


def quote(m):
    return f'"{m}"' if "-" in m else m


def typ(m):
    return "(e: any) => void" if m.startswith("on") else ("any" if m in ("style", "children") else "string")


NOTE = ["className", "style", "onClick", "id", "children"]
# ------------------------------------------------------------------ dependency package `dep`
DEP_INNER = "\n".join([
    iface("DepBig", members("a", 201, NOTE)),
    iface("DepBig200", members("b", 200, NOTE)),
    iface("DepBig199", members("c", 199)),
    iface("DepOther", members("d", 201, ["a5", "className"])),  # shares a5 and className with DepBig
    alias("DepAlias", members("e", 201, NOTE)),
    iface("PanelHTMLAttributes", members("f", 31, ["className", "onClick"])),  # ambient by spelling, API by meaning
    iface("Amb30HTMLAttributes", members("g", 30)),
    iface("Amb29HTMLAttributes", members("h", 29)),
    iface("BoxStyleProps", members("i", 31, ["style"])),
    "export interface DepChild extends DepBig {\n  /** narrowed */\n  a1?: 'narrow';\n  child0?: string;\n}\n",
    "export interface DepGen<T = string> {\n" + "\n".join(f"  j{i}?: T;" for i in range(201)) + "\n}\n",
    "export type DepOmit = Omit<DepBig, 'a0'>;\n",
    "export type DepPick = Pick<DepBig, 'a0' | 'className'>;\n",
    "export interface DepExtendsTwo extends DepBig199, DepBig200 {}\n",
])
DEP_INDEX = "export * from './inner';\nexport type { DepBig as DepBigRe } from './inner';\n"

# ------------------------------------------------------------------ project sources
PROJ_BIG = "\n".join([
    iface("ProjBig", members("p", 201, NOTE)),
    alias("ProjAlias", members("q", 201, NOTE)),
    iface("ProjBig200", members("r", 200)),
    "export interface ProjChild extends ProjBig {\n  p1?: 'narrow';\n  pc?: string;\n}\n",
    iface("ProjMid", members("s", 40, ["className"])),  # past 30, under 200: collapses only under `all`
])

H = "import * as React from 'react';\nimport type { DepBig, DepBig200, DepBig199, DepOther, DepAlias, PanelHTMLAttributes, Amb30HTMLAttributes, Amb29HTMLAttributes, BoxStyleProps, DepChild, DepGen, DepOmit, DepPick, DepBigRe, DepExtendsTwo } from 'dep';\nimport type { ProjBig, ProjAlias, ProjBig200, ProjChild, ProjMid } from './big';\n"
OWN = "{ own: string; /** own doc */ ownOpt?: number }"

# (id, declarations, props type of the component, component wrapper form)
CASES = [
    ("ext", f"interface P extends DepBig {OWN[1:]}", "P", "fn"),
    ("inter", "", f"DepBig & {OWN}", "fn"),
    ("omit2", "", f"Omit<DepBig, 'a0' | 'a1'> & {OWN}", "fn"),
    ("omit1", "", f"Omit<DepBig, 'a0'> & {OWN}", "fn"),
    ("omitNone", "", f"Omit<DepBig, 'zzz'> & {OWN}", "fn"),
    ("omitClass", "", f"Omit<DepBig, 'className'> & {OWN}", "fn"),
    ("omitNested", "", f"Omit<Omit<DepBig, 'a0'>, 'a1'> & {OWN}", "fn"),
    ("omitTpl", "", f"Omit<DepBig, `a${{1 | 2}}`> & {OWN}", "fn"),
    ("omitKeyofOther", "interface K { a0: 1; a1: 1 }", f"Omit<DepBig, keyof K> & {OWN}", "fn"),
    ("omitKeyofOwn", "interface O { a1: 'mine'; className: 'mine'; own: string }", "Omit<DepBig, keyof O> & O", "fn"),
    ("omitExclude", "", "Omit<DepBig, Exclude<keyof DepBig, 'a0' | 'className'>>", "fn"),
    ("omitAliasLocal", "type A = Omit<DepBig, 'a0'>", f"A & {OWN}", "fn"),
    ("omitAliasDep", "", f"DepOmit & {OWN}", "fn"),
    ("omitGenericDefault", "type G<K extends string = 'a0'> = Omit<DepBig, K>", f"G & {OWN}", "fn"),
    ("omitOfExt", f"interface P extends DepBig {OWN[1:]}", "Omit<P, 'a0'>", "fn"),
    ("pick", "", f"Pick<DepBig, 'a0' | 'className'> & {OWN}", "fn"),
    ("pickAll", "", "Pick<DepBig, keyof DepBig>", "fn"),
    ("pickExtract", "", "Pick<DepBig, Extract<keyof DepBig, `a1${string}`>>", "fn"),
    ("pickDep", "", f"DepPick & {OWN}", "fn"),
    ("pickAndWhole", "", "Pick<DepBig, 'a0'> & DepBig", "fn"),
    ("partial", "", f"Partial<DepBig> & {OWN}", "fn"),
    ("required", "", f"Required<DepBig> & {OWN}", "fn"),
    ("readonly", "", f"Readonly<DepBig> & {OWN}", "fn"),
    ("mappedInline", "", "{ [K in keyof DepBig]?: DepBig[K] }", "fn"),
    ("mappedAs", "", "{ [K in keyof DepBig as K extends `a${string}` ? K : never]?: DepBig[K] }", "fn"),
    ("cond", "", f"(DepBig extends object ? DepBig : never) & {OWN}", "fn"),
    ("union", "", "(DepBig & { kind: 'a' }) | (DepBig & { kind: 'b'; bOnly: string })", "fn"),
    ("genericW", "type W<T> = T & { own: string }", "W<DepBig>", "fn"),
    ("depGen", "", "DepGen<number>", "fn"),
    ("redeclare", "interface P extends DepBig { a1: 'narrow'; className: 'mine'; own: string }", "P", "fn"),
    ("redeclareInter", "", "DepBig & { a1: 'narrow'; className: 'mine'; own: string }", "fn"),
    ("depChild", "", f"DepChild & {OWN}", "fn"),
    ("twoSources", "", f"DepBig & DepOther & {OWN}", "fn"),
    ("sameTwice", "", "DepBig & Omit<DepBig, 'a0'>", "fn"),
    ("reexport", "", f"DepBigRe & {OWN}", "fn"),
    ("extendsTwo", "", "DepExtendsTwo", "fn"),
    ("aliasDep", "", f"DepAlias & {OWN}", "fn"),
    ("aliasDepOmit", "", f"Omit<DepAlias, 'e0'> & {OWN}", "fn"),
    ("aliasProj", "", f"ProjAlias & {OWN}", "fn"),
    ("projExt", f"interface P extends ProjBig {OWN[1:]}", "P", "fn"),
    ("projChild", "", "ProjChild", "fn"),
    ("projOmit", "", f"Omit<ProjBig, 'p0'> & {OWN}", "fn"),
    ("proj200", "", "ProjBig200", "fn"),
    ("projMid", "", f"ProjMid & {OWN}", "fn"),
    ("thr200", "", "DepBig200", "fn"),
    ("thr199", "", "DepBig199", "fn"),
    ("amb31", "", f"PanelHTMLAttributes & {OWN}", "fn"),
    ("amb30", "", "Amb30HTMLAttributes", "fn"),
    ("amb29", "", "Amb29HTMLAttributes", "fn"),
    ("style31", "", "BoxStyleProps", "fn"),
    ("divAndDep", "", "React.ComponentProps<'div'> & DepBig", "fn"),
    ("htmlAndDep", "", "React.HTMLAttributes<HTMLDivElement> & DepBig", "fn"),
    ("cpwrAndDep", "", "React.ComponentPropsWithoutRef<'button'> & Omit<DepBig, 'onClick'>", "fn"),
    ("jsxIntrinsic", "", "JSX.IntrinsicElements['div'] & DepBig", "fn"),
    ("poly", "", "{ as?: React.ElementType } & DepBig", "fn"),
    ("propsOf", "function Inner(p: DepBig & { inner: string }) { return null }", "React.ComponentProps<typeof Inner>", "fn"),
    ("fwd", f"interface P extends DepBig {OWN[1:]}", "P", "forwardRef"),
    ("memo", f"interface P extends DepBig {OWN[1:]}", "P", "memo"),
    ("cls", f"interface P extends DepBig {OWN[1:]}", "P", "class"),
    ("dflt", f"interface P extends DepBig {OWN[1:]}", "P", "defaults"),
    ("children", "", "DepBig", "fn"),
    ("keyRef", "", "DepBig & React.RefAttributes<HTMLDivElement> & { key?: string }", "fn"),
]


def component(cid, decls, ptype, form):
    n = f"C_{cid}"
    pre = H + (decls + "\n" if decls else "")
    pre += f"export type Props_{cid} = {ptype};\n"
    t = f"Props_{cid}"
    if form == "fn":
        body = f"export function {n}(props: {t}) {{ return <div /> }}\n"
    elif form == "forwardRef":
        body = f"export const {n} = React.forwardRef<HTMLDivElement, {t}>(function {n}(props, ref) {{ return <div ref={{ref}} /> }});\n"
    elif form == "memo":
        body = f"export const {n} = React.memo(function {n}(props: {t}) {{ return <div /> }});\n"
    elif form == "class":
        body = f"export class {n} extends React.Component<{t}> {{ render() {{ return <div /> }} }}\n"
    elif form == "defaults":
        body = f"export function {n}({{ className = 'dflt', a3 = 'three', ...rest }}: {t}) {{ return <div className={{className}} /> }}\n"
    return pre + body


def write_project(group):
    proj = ROOT / "projects" / group
    (proj / "src").mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    (proj / "node_modules/dep").mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    (proj / "node_modules/@types").mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    for link, target in [("node_modules/@types/react", NM / "@types/react"), ("node_modules/csstype", NM / "csstype"), ("node_modules/react", NM / "react")]:
        p = proj / link
        if not p.exists():
            p.symlink_to(target)
    (proj / "node_modules/dep/package.json").write_text('{"name":"dep","version":"1.0.0","types":"index.d.ts"}')
    (proj / "node_modules/dep/index.d.ts").write_text(DEP_INDEX)
    (proj / "node_modules/dep/inner.d.ts").write_text(DEP_INNER)
    (proj / "package.json").write_text('{"name":"rt","private":true,"dependencies":{"dep":"1.0.0","react":"*"}}')
    (proj / "tsconfig.json").write_text(TSCONFIG)
    (proj / "src/big.ts").write_text(PROJ_BIG)
    for cid, decls, ptype, form in CASES:
        (proj / "src" / f"C_{cid}.tsx").write_text(component(cid, decls, ptype, form))
    return proj


def run(proj, lane, mode):
    args = [BIN, "extract", "-s", str(proj / "src"), "--json", "--quiet", "--no-cache", "--collapse-inherited-props", mode]
    if lane == "S":
        args.append("--no-checker")
    if lane == "C":
        args.append("--no-structural-fallback")
    res = subprocess.run(args, capture_output=True, text=True, cwd=proj, timeout=600)
    if res.returncode != 0:
        print("FAIL", lane, mode, res.stderr[:800], file=sys.stderr)
        return None
    return json.loads(res.stdout)


def oracle(proj):
    res = subprocess.run(["node", str(ROOT / "oracle.cjs"), str(proj)], capture_output=True, text=True, timeout=600)
    if res.returncode != 0:
        print(res.stderr[:2000], file=sys.stderr)
        sys.exit(1)
    return json.loads(res.stdout)


def components(out):
    comps = out.get("components", out)
    if isinstance(comps, dict):
        comps = list(comps.values())
    return {c.get("displayName") or c.get("name"): c for c in comps}


def judge(cname, comp, truth, lane, mode):
    """Findings for one component in one lane: (class, detail)."""
    f = []
    props = comp.get("props", {}) or {}
    notable = comp.get("notableInherited", {}) or {}
    layers = comp.get("inheritance", []) or []
    reach = {p["name"]: p for p in truth["props"]}
    held = collections.Counter()
    for layer in layers:
        for m in layer.get("members", []) or []:
            held[m] += 1
            if m not in reach:
                f.append(("LAYER_MEMBER_NOT_REACHING", f"{layer.get('typeName')}.{m}"))
            else:
                parents = {d["parent"] for d in reach[m]["decls"]}
                if layer.get("typeName") not in parents:
                    f.append(("LAYER_HOLDS_OTHER_SOURCE_PROP", f"{layer.get('typeName')}.{m} decl={sorted(p or '-' for p in parents)}"))
    for name, p in reach.items():
        react = all(d["react"] for d in p["decls"])
        n = (name in props) + (name in notable) + held[name]
        if react:
            if n > 1:
                f.append(("DUP_REACT", name))
            continue
        own = any(d["own"] for d in p["decls"])
        if n == 0:
            f.append(("LOSS", name))
        elif n > 1:
            where = [w for w, c in (("list", name in props), ("notable", name in notable), (f"layer x{held[name]}", held[name])) if c]
            f.append(("DUP", f"{name} in {'+'.join(where)}"))
        if own and held[name]:
            f.append(("OWN_IN_LAYER", name))
        if own and name in notable:
            f.append(("OWN_AS_NOTABLE", name))
    for name in list(props) + list(notable):
        if name not in reach:
            f.append(("PHANTOM", name))
    return f


def collapsed(comp):
    return sorted(l.get("typeName") for l in comp.get("inheritance", []) or [] if l.get("members"))


def main():
    groups = sys.argv[1:] or ["dependencies", "all", "none"]
    proj = write_project("g")
    truth = oracle(proj)
    report = {"oracle_components": len(truth), "rows": [], "lanes": {}, "determinism": {}}
    for mode in groups:
        outs = {lane: run(proj, lane, mode) for lane in ("S", "M", "C")}
        again = run(proj, "M", mode)
        strip = lambda o: json.dumps({k: v for k, v in (o or {}).items() if k != "stats"}, sort_keys=True)
        report["determinism"][mode] = strip(outs["M"]) == strip(again)
        comps = {lane: components(o) if o else {} for lane, o in outs.items()}
        (ROOT / "out").mkdir(exist_ok=True)
        for lane, o in outs.items():
            (ROOT / "out" / f"{mode}-{lane}.json").write_text(json.dumps(o, indent=1))
        for cname, t in sorted(truth.items()):
            lanes = {}
            for lane in ("S", "M", "C"):
                c = comps[lane].get(cname)
                if c is None:
                    report["rows"].append([mode, lane, cname, "MISSING_COMPONENT", ""])
                    continue
                lanes[lane] = collapsed(c)
                for cls, d in judge(cname, c, t, lane, mode):
                    report["rows"].append([mode, lane, cname, cls, d])
            if len({json.dumps(v) for v in lanes.values()}) > 1:
                report["rows"].append([mode, "SMC", cname, "LANE_DISAGREE", json.dumps(lanes)])
            report["lanes"].setdefault(mode, {})[cname] = lanes
    (ROOT / "report.json").write_text(json.dumps(report, indent=1))
    summary = collections.Counter((r[0], r[1], r[3]) for r in report["rows"])
    for k, v in sorted(summary.items()):
        print(*k, v)
    print("determinism", report["determinism"])


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()

# Red team: collapse decision and layering at fix/collapse-never-hide-on-silence (6aea3f4a)

Nothing was fixed and no repo file changed. The binary was built from `git archive 6aea3f4a` in `shrink/redteam-collapse-src`, with `CARGO_TARGET_DIR=shrink/redteam-collapse-target` and rust 1.99.1.

Harness (scratch, not committed), in `/Users/gabe/Projects/caliper-fixtures/redteam-collapse/`:
- `gen.py` writes one project (`projects/g`) with 102 components. Each component is one grammar form over these sources:
  - dependency `dep`: interfaces of 201/200/199 members, a type-literal alias of 201, `*HTMLAttributes` of 29/30/31, `BoxStyleProps` 31, `DepChild extends DepBig` (narrows `a1`), `DepOther` (shares `a5` and `className`), `DepGen<T>`, an augmented `DepAug` (200 + 1 in `src/aug.ts`), a re-export;
  - project: an interface of 201, a type-literal alias of 201, `ProjBig200`, `ProjChild`, `ProjMid` 40.
- Lanes:
  - S `--no-checker`;
  - M default (merged);
  - C `--no-structural-fallback` (checker only);
  - and, under `dependencies`, also T `--semantic-timeout-ms 1` and N `--no-load-dependencies`.
- Each lane runs under all three modes, `dependencies` (the default and the addon's), `all` and `none`.
- `oracle.cjs` is the ground truth: TypeScript 5.9.3 `getPropertiesOfType` of each `Props_<id>` alias (the union of its arms for a union), with every declaration's parent and file.
- `analyze.py` checks the invariants and writes `rows.json`. A notable prop that copies a member of a same-source layer is the layer contract, not a duplicate.
- `corpus.sh` and `corpus.py` measure how often each class occurs, and the cost of the allow-list, on gate-large, chakra-only and shadcn-ui (`apps/v4`, 612 components).

## Invariant results

1. Every reaching prop appears exactly once (list, notable or layers). **Violated**: by loss in D1, by duplication in D2, D3, D4 and D7.
2. Own props are never in a layer. **Violated** in D3: an own redeclaration stays a layer member. In D3c an own prop is moved to `notableInherited` as the dependency's.
3. Every member of a collapsed layer reaches the component. **Violated** in D5 (an omitted key stays held, and props that do not exist appear). In D3 the base layer holds a member that a redeclaration overrides.
4. Lanes agree. On the 79 forms the structural lane can read, S, M and C collapse the same sources in all three modes. The decision still changes with how the type is spelled (D3b, D7). Checker-only forms (`Parameters<typeof f>[0]`, `Cfg['props']`) differ only because S cannot read them at all; that is expected.
5. Determinism. **Holds**:
   - M is byte-identical across two runs (stats dropped) in every mode.
   - Every component that shares a source without an Omit gets the same member list.
   - T (1 ms timeout) equals S on all 102 components.

Totals in `rows.json` (rows over modes and lanes, then distinct components):
- DUP: 3722 rows, 17 components;
- LOSS: 10101 rows, 21 components (most of it structural-lane loss on forms S declines, see Out of scope);
- LOSS_OWN: 22 rows, 2 components;
- LAYER_MEMBER_NOT_REACHING: 2424 rows, 3 components;
- PHANTOM: 467 rows, 4 components;
- LAYER_HOLDS_OVERRIDDEN_PROP: 30 rows, 4 components;
- OWN_AS_NOTABLE: 4 rows, 1 component;
- IN_TWO_LAYERS: 12 rows, 1 component;
- LANE_DISAGREE: 14 rows, 7 components (all checker-only forms).

## Discrepancy classes, grouped by the fact the decision lacked

### D1 (worst: silent loss in the default lane). "React's" means any one declaration is in @types/react
- Where:
  - `is_react_declared` (`crates/semantic/src/component.rs:35`) is `declarations.iter().any(...)`;
  - `apply_props` (`crates/core/src/types/semantic.rs:376-380`) drops every `react_declared` prop of a component that has a layer;
  - `Unanswered::Drop` then drops the structural prop as well.
- A prop that the user or a dependency also declares, in an intersection with a React type, is lost in M and C. The element layer stands for React's attribute, so the user's own type, JSDoc, and the name itself (`key`, `children`) are gone.
- Repros (M and C, every mode, `none` included):
  - `React.ComponentProps<'div'> & { className: 'mine'; onClick: (x: number) => void; title: 'own'; own: string }` loses `className`, `onClick` and `title`; S lists them (C_ownOverReact).
  - `DepBig & React.RefAttributes<HTMLDivElement> & { key?: string }` loses the own `key` (C_keyRef).
  - `React.ComponentPropsWithoutRef<'button'> & Omit<DepBig, 'onClick'>` loses DepBig's `className`, `style`, `id` and `children` (C_cpwrAndDep).
  - The same happens wherever DepBig is listed, not collapsed: `ComponentProps<'div'> & DepBig` under `none`, and `Parameters<typeof f>[0] & ComponentProps<'div'>`, each lose 5 props.
- Missing fact: every declaration of the prop is React's (C1: one React declaration was taken as proof).
- Corpora: 0 detected. I compared S-lane props with a non-dependency parent, absent from M, in components with an element layer.
  - Latent case: Chakra `SystemProperties` members `color`, `content` and `translate` are also React names. They are safe today only because the source collapses (588 gate-large components). An Omit that drops the source under the threshold, in a component with an element layer, would lose them.

### D2. A type-literal alias source is both collapsed and fully listed (merged and checker lanes)
- Repros (M and C under `dependencies` and `all`; S is correct):
  - `DepAlias & {...}` and `ProjAlias & {...}`: the layer holds 201 members and the same 201 props are also listed;
  - a checker-only `PropsOf<typeof W>` with `W: FC<DepAlias>` does the same.
- Cause: the checker names no `parent` for a type-literal member. `keeps` keeps every prop with no parent (semantic.rs:692), and the structural layer holds members by (name, alias).
- This confirms review item 1 of the PR body as a regression.
- Missing fact: a type-literal member's binding to its alias.
- Corpora: 0.

### D3. A redeclared or overridden member stays in the layer and counts toward the threshold
- Repros (all lanes, `dependencies` and `all`, unless noted):
  - `interface P extends DepBig { a1: 'narrow'; className: 'mine' }`: the own `a1` and `className` are listed and also held by the DepBig layer (C_redeclare). The intersection form does the same (C_redeclareInter).
  - `DepChild` (a dependency child that narrows `a1`): the DepBig layer holds `a1`, and `a1` is listed (C_depChild). The same holds for ProjChild.
  - `interface P extends DepBig { a0: string }` (C_redeclareThreshold):
    - 201 declared, 200 reach, so the source should be listed at the threshold;
    - it collapses, and `a0` is both listed and in the layer.
  - `& { a0?: never }` and `Pick<DepBig,'a0'> & DepBig`: `a0` is listed and in the layer.
  - D3b (spelling): the structural lane counts what the source declares, the checker counts by parent. So the same type `DepChild` collapses DepBig at 201 when written directly. Written as `Parameters<typeof f>[0]`, the checker counts 200 and lists it.
  - D3c (checker lane, C_coParamsRedeclare): `Base & { a1: 'narrow'; className: 'mine' }` with a checker-only Base:
    - `a1` is listed and in the layer;
    - the own `className` is moved to `notableInherited` with `parent: DepBig`, because the checker's single `parent` is the first declaration.
- Missing fact: whether the prop's effective declaration is this source. The decision counts names the source declares, not members whose only declaration is the source.
- Corpora: 1 component in both gate-large and chakra-only, `ChakraDatePickerDayTable`. `offset` is listed with parent `DatePickerDayTableProps` and also held by the `SystemProperties` layer.

### D4. The same source reached by a listed path and a collapsed path
- Repro (all lanes): `DepBig & Omit<DepBig, 'a0'>`. The Omit path has 200 members and is listed; the plain path has 201 and collapses. All 200 props are listed and also in the layer.
- Cause: the decision is made per path. `one_layer_per_collapsed_source` merges only layers.
- Missing fact: the union of all paths' reaching members, decided once per (component, source).

### D5. An Omit key set that is not a literal union is read as "omits nothing" (C1)
- Repros (all lanes; TypeScript gives `{}` for the first two):
  - `Omit<DepBig, string>`: a layer of 201 members, none of which reach, plus 4 phantom `notableInherited` props (`className`, `id`, `onClick`, `style`);
  - `Omit<DepBig, 'a0' | (string & {})>`: the same;
  - ``Omit<DepBig, `a${1|2}`>``: `a1` and `a2` stay layer members although TypeScript removed them.
- Cause in `resolver/alias.rs:42-55`: an unknown key set leaves `state.omitted` unchanged, and `resolve_key_set_or_warn` returning `None` returns the chain unfiltered.
- Missing fact: whether the key set is finite and resolved.

### D6. A layer drops the component's destructuring defaults
- A default on any member in a layer is lost in every lane: `{ a3 = 'three' }` leaves `a3` only in the layer (C_dflt, C_checkerOnlyDflt, C_coParamsDflt).
- In a layer the checker made, even the notable default is lost: `className = 'dflt'` gives `defaultValue: null` on the notable prop (C_coParamsDflt). A layer the structural pass made keeps `'dflt'`.
- Missing fact: the component's destructuring, which the decision never reads.

### D7. A prop with several declarations is attributed to one parent (two counts)
- Repros:
  - Checker-only `DepBig & DepOther`: DepOther counts 199, because the shared `a5` and `className` are attributed to DepBig, so it is listed. The structural spelling collapses both, and `a5` and `className` then sit in two layers.
  - An interface augmented from another file (`declare module 'dep' { interface DepAug { augmented } }`) is split by file into 200 + 1. TypeScript gives 201 reaching, so it should collapse; both lanes list it.
- The cost is size and consistency, not loss.
- Missing fact: provenance as (source, key, every declaration), not a single parent.

### D8. Ambient by spelling (C3)
- A dependency's API interface named `PanelHTMLAttributes` (31 members: `className`, `onClick` and 29 API props) collapses at the ambient threshold of 30 in every lane. The suffix `*HTMLAttributes`, `*StyleProps` or `Aria*Attributes` is taken as evidence.
- Missing fact: the declaration's binding (a DOM file), not its name.

### D9. Essential props that are not on the notable list are hidden in layers
- `notable_html_attrs("")` is `onClick, onFocus, onBlur, className, style, id, tabIndex, aria-label`.
- A collapsed source's `children`, `key` or `ref` (C_children) exists only as a layer name, with no type.
- This is policy, not a bug, but the brief counts these names as notable.

Thresholds behave as specified in both lanes:
- 199, 200 and 201 members;
- ambient 29, 30 and 31;
- Omit taking 201 to 200 or 199 lists the source;
- `Omit<..., 'zzz'>` stays at 201 and collapses;
- under `all`, `ProjMid` 40 and `ProjBig200` collapse;
- `forwardRef`, `memo`, `memo(forwardRef)`, class components, polymorphic `as`, re-exports and `ComponentProps<typeof X>` all agree.

## Proposed closed allow-list: collapse source X in component C only when all of these are proven, otherwise list

1. **Binding.** X is identified by its declaration, either an interface, or a type-literal alias whose members both lanes attribute to X. A member with no proven owner is never held (D2).
2. **Path.** Every path from C's props type to X is one of:
   - the props type itself;
   - an intersection member;
   - an interface or class base, including a generic instantiation;
   - lib `Partial`, `Required` or `Readonly`;
   - lib `Omit` whose key set is a finite union of string literals, fully resolved.

   Anything else lists X: `Pick`, a mapped type, a conditional, an indexed access, a union arm not proven per arm, `string`, a branded string, a template literal or an unresolved key set (D5).
3. **Members.** The layer's members are those that X declares and that reach C with X as their only declaration, after Omit. They are the union over all paths, decided once per (C, X). Exclude from the layer, and list, any member that is also declared by:
   - C's own type;
   - a derived interface;
   - another source;
   - an intersection narrowing.

   This covers D3, D4 and D7.
4. **Count.** One function computes the count from rule 3, and both lanes call it with the same provenance. Collapse only when the count is over the threshold, so a redeclaration can drop X under it (D3, D3b).
5. **Code facts.** No member is named in C's destructuring (a default or a rest exclusion). Such members are listed (D6).
6. **Ambient.** Only the declaring file proves a source ambient, not its name (D8).
7. **Layering, separate from collapse.** A prop is React's only when every declaration of it is in @types/react (D1).

### Size cost (merged lane, from the `corpus/M-*.json` this binary produced)
- Rules 1, 3 and 4, applied per member (only the offending member is listed):
  - gate-large: 1 of 608 components with a layer; 1 member listed (`offset`);
  - chakra-only: 1 of 608; 1 member;
  - shadcn-ui: 0 of 6.
- The same rules applied to whole sources (any failing member lists the source):
  - gate-large: 1 component, 705 members listed;
  - chakra-only: 1 component, 705 members listed;
  - shadcn-ui: 0.
- Not measured from output: rule 2 (the Omit key form is not in the output), rule 5 (destructuring) and rule 6. All shadcn layers are `GlobalDOMEvents` from `@react-types/shared/src/dom.d.ts`, which is ambient by file, so rule 6 would not change them.

## Out of scope but seen (not caused by collapse)
- The structural lane loses everything (2 props kept) for these forms:

1. **Binding.** X is identified by its declaration, either an interface, or a type-literal alias whose members both lanes attribute to X. A member with no proven owner is never held (D2).
2. **Path.** Every path from C's props type to X is one of:
   - the props type itself;
   - an intersection member;
   - an interface or class base, including a generic instantiation;
   - lib `Partial`, `Required` or `Readonly`;
   - lib `Omit` whose key set is a finite union of string literals, fully resolved.

   Anything else lists X: `Pick`, a mapped type, a conditional, an indexed access, a union arm not proven per arm, `string`, a branded string, a template literal or an unresolved key set (D5).
3. **Members.** The layer's members are those that X declares and that reach C with X as their only declaration, after Omit. They are the union over all paths, decided once per (C, X). Exclude from the layer, and list, any member that is also declared by:
   - C's own type;
   - a derived interface;
   - another source;
   - an intersection narrowing.

   This covers D3, D4 and D7.
4. **Count.** One function computes the count from rule 3, and both lanes call it with the same provenance. Collapse only when the count is over the threshold, so a redeclaration can drop X under it (D3, D3b).
5. **Code facts.** No member is named in C's destructuring (a default or a rest exclusion). Such members are listed (D6).
6. **Ambient.** Only the declaring file proves a source ambient, not its name (D8).
7. **Layering, separate from collapse.** A prop is React's only when every declaration of it is in @types/react (D1).

### Size cost (merged lane, from the `corpus/M-*.json` this binary produced)
- Rules 1, 3 and 4, applied per member (only the offending member is listed):
  - gate-large: 1 of 608 components with a layer; 1 member listed (`offset`);
  - chakra-only: 1 of 608; 1 member;
  - shadcn-ui: 0 of 6.
- The same rules applied to whole sources (any failing member lists the source):
  - gate-large: 1 component, 705 members listed;
  - chakra-only: 1 component, 705 members listed;
  - shadcn-ui: 0.
- Not measured from output: rule 2 (the Omit key form is not in the output), rule 5 (destructuring) and rule 6. All shadcn layers are `GlobalDOMEvents` from `@react-types/shared/src/dom.d.ts`, which is ambient by file, so rule 6 would not change them.

## Out of scope but seen (not caused by collapse)
- The structural lane loses everything (2 props kept) for these forms:
  - a conditional props type;
  - `Parameters<typeof f>[0]`;
  - `Cfg['props']` is the exception: it is read.
- `Pick<DepBig, Extract<keyof DepBig, `a1${string}`>>` loses 107 props in S, because `props.clear()` runs on an unresolved key set.
- A mapped type with `as` creates phantom props in S.
- S lists every React attribute for `ComponentPropsWithoutRef<'button'> & ...` (484 props) and for `ComponentProps<'div'> & {...}` (280), and the own `className` takes React's parent.
- A TSX syntax error makes `extract --quiet` exit non-zero with empty stderr.

## Not done
- No mutation proof and no oracle or corpus fetches. The corpora were the local ones.
- `html-attributes full` and `none` were not crossed with collapse.
- No generic components with type-parameter keys at the call site, beyond defaults.
- No incremental or cache paths. The `Layering::kept` vs merge mismatch is filtered silently in release builds (semantic.rs:465), but no input that triggers it was found.
